title: Case 024: Oven repair request
initial_request:
Oven not/cooking warming food

For reference it takes more than double the amount of time to cook anything than usual
E.g. nuggets or chips still uncooked after 1.30hrs
overview: The tenant reported that the oven was not heating food properly, saying cooking took more than twice as long as usual. Northbridge Lettings first sent a manual with suggested settings. The tenant replied that the oven had not worked since moving in despite trying those settings and asked for an inspection. The landlord approved sending an appliance repair contractor, and Lantern Works was assigned. A manual and a photo were referenced in emails; both attachments remain unavailable, so their contents are not known. The tenant also sent unrelated requests or updates about a fence, a conservatory roof leak, and another previously reported issue. The agency later said the fence and oven had been fixed, recorded receipt of an invoice, and completed the request without payment.
outcome: Northbridge Lettings told the tenant that the oven had been fixed and the request was closed. The request was marked completed without payment.
